## Create a project API token.

<a id="opIdcreateProjectApiToken"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://app.getunleash.io/demo/api/admin/projects/string/api-tokens \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "type": "frontend",
    "environment": "development",
    "expiresAt": "2023-10-01T00:00:00Z",
    "tokenName": "some-user"
  }'
```

`POST /api/admin/projects/{projectId}/api-tokens`

Endpoint that allows creation of [project API tokens](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/api-tokens-and-client-keys#api-token-visibility) for the specified project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "type": "frontend",
  "environment": "development",
  "expiresAt": "2023-10-01T00:00:00Z",
  "tokenName": "some-user"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-project-api-token-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|projectId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[createProjectApiTokenSchema](#schemacreateprojectapitokenschema)|true|createProjectApiTokenSchema|
|» type|body|string|true|A client or frontend token. Must be one of the strings "client" (deprecated), "backend" (preferred over "client") or "frontend" (not case sensitive).|
|» environment|body|string|false|The environment that the token should be valid for. Defaults to "default".|
|» expiresAt|body|string(date-time)|false|The date and time when the token should expire. The date should be in ISO 8601 format.|
|» tokenName|body|string|true|A unique name for this particular token|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "secret": "project:environment.xyzrandomstring",
  "tokenName": "some-user",
  "type": "client",
  "environment": "development",
  "project": "developerexperience",
  "projects": [
    "developerexperience",
    "enterprisegrowth"
  ],
```

## Add a user via a signup token

<a id="opIdaddPublicSignupTokenUser"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://app.getunleash.io/demo/invite/string/signup \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{

    "name": "Hunter Burgan",
    "password": "hunter2"
  }'
```

`POST /invite/{token}/signup`

## Update a public signup token

<a id="opIdupdatePublicSignupToken"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://app.getunleash.io/demo/api/admin/invite-link/tokens/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "expiresAt": "2023-04-11T15:46:56Z",
    "enabled": true
  }'
```

`PUT /api/admin/invite-link/tokens/{token}`

Update information about a specific token. The `:token` part of the URL should be the token's secret.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "expiresAt": "2023-04-11T15:46:56Z",
  "enabled": true
}
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
|token|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[publicSignupTokenUpdateSchema](#schemapublicsignuptokenupdateschema)|true|publicSignupTokenUpdateSchema|
|» expiresAt|body|string(date-time)|false|The token's expiration date.|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether the token is active or not.|

<h1 id="unleash-api-search">Search</h1>

Search for features.

## Search and filter features

<a id="opIdsearchFeatures"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://app.getunleash.io/demo/api/admin/search/features \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /api/admin/search/features`

Search and filter by selected fields.

<h3 id="search-and-filter-features-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|query|query|string|false|The search query for the feature name or tag|
|project|query|string|false|Id of the project where search and filter is performed. The project id can be specified with an operator. The supported operators are IS, IS_NOT, IS_ANY_OF, IS_NONE_OF.|
|state|query|string|false|The state of the feature active/stale. The state can be specified with an operator. The supported operators are IS, IS_NOT, IS_ANY_OF, IS_NONE_OF.|
|lifecycle|query|string|false|The lifecycle stage of the feature. The stage can be specified with an operator. The supported operators are IS, IS_NOT, IS_ANY_OF, IS_NONE_OF.|
|type|query|string|false|The feature flag type to filter by. The type can be specified with an operator. The supported operators are IS, IS_NOT, IS_ANY_OF, IS_NONE_OF.|
|createdBy|query|string|false|The feature flag creator to filter by. The creators can be specified with an operator. The supported operators are IS, IS_NOT, IS_ANY_OF, IS_NONE_OF.|
|tag|query|string|false|The list of feature tags to filter by. Feature tag has to specify a type and a value joined with a colon.|
|segment|query|string|false|The list of segments with operators to filter by. The segment valid operators are INCLUDE, DO_NOT_INCLUDE, INCLUDE_ALL_OF, INCLUDE_ANY_OF, EXCLUDE_IF_ANY_OF, EXCLUDE_ALL.|
|status|query|[string]|false|The list of feature environment status to filter by. Feature environment has to specify a name and a status joined with a colon.|
|offset|query|string|false|The number of features to skip when returning a page. By default it is set to 0.|
|limit|query|string|false|The number of feature environments to return in a page. By default it is set to 50.|
|sortBy|query|string|false|The field to sort the results by. By default it is set to "createdAt".|
|sortOrder|query|string|false|The sort order for the sortBy. By default it is det to "asc".|
|favoritesFirst|query|string|false|The flag to indicate if the favorite features should be returned first. By default it is set to false.|
|archived|query|string|false|**Deprecated.** Deprecated: use the `lifecycle` parameter instead (`lifecycle=IS:archived` is equivalent to `archived=IS:true`). Whether to get results for archived feature flags or active feature flags. If `IS:true`, Unleash will return only archived flags, taking precedence over any `lifecycle` filter. If `IS:false`, it will return only active flags.|
|favorite|query|string|false|Filter by whether the feature is favorited by the current user. Use IS:true to show only favorites.|
|createdAt|query|string|false|The date the feature was created. The date can be specified with an operator. The supported operators are IS_BEFORE, IS_ON_OR_AFTER.|
|lastSeenAt|query|string|false|The date the feature was last seen from metrics. The date can be specified with an operator. The supported operators are IS_BEFORE, IS_ON_OR_AFTER.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sortOrder|asc|
|sortOrder|desc|

## Update segment by id

<a id="opIdupdateSegment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://app.getunleash.io/demo/api/admin/segments/0 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "beta-users",
    "description": "Users willing to help us test and build new features.",
    "project": "red-vista",
    "constraints": [
      {
        "contextName": "appName",
        "operator": "IN",
        "caseInsensitive": false,
        "inverted": false,
        "values": [
          "my-app",
          "my-other-app"
        ],
        "value": "my-app"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /api/admin/segments/{id}`

Updates the content of the segment with the provided payload. Requires `name` and `constraints` to be present. If `project` is not present, it will be set to `null`. Any other fields not specified will be left untouched.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "beta-users",
  "description": "Users willing to help us test and build new features.",
  "project": "red-vista",
  "constraints": [
    {
      "contextName": "appName",
      "operator": "IN",
      "caseInsensitive": false,
      "inverted": false,
      "values": [
        "my-app",
        "my-other-app"
      ],
      "value": "my-app"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="update-segment-by-id-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer|true|a segment id|
|body|body|[upsertSegmentSchema](#schemaupsertsegmentschema)|true|upsertSegmentSchema|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the segment|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|A description of what the segment is for|

## Create a strategy

<a id="opIdcreateStrategy"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://app.getunleash.io/demo/api/admin/strategies \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "my-custom-strategy",
    "title": "My awesome strategy",
    "description": "Enable the feature for users who have not logged in before.",
    "editable": false,
    "deprecated": true,
    "parameters": [
      {
        "name": "Rollout percentage",
        "type": "percentage",
        "description": "How many percent of users should see this feature?",
        "required": false
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/admin/strategies`

Creates a custom strategy type based on the supplied data.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "my-custom-strategy",
  "title": "My awesome strategy",
  "description": "Enable the feature for users who have not logged in before.",
  "editable": false,
  "deprecated": true,
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "Rollout percentage",
      "type": "percentage",
      "description": "How many percent of users should see this feature?",
      "required": false
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-strategy-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[createStrategySchema](#schemacreatestrategyschema)|true|createStrategySchema|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the strategy type. Must be unique.|
|» title|body|string|false|The title of the strategy|
|» description|body|string|false|A description of the strategy type.|
|» editable|body|boolean|false|Whether the strategy type is editable or not. Defaults to `true`.|
|» deprecated|body|boolean|false|Whether the strategy type is deprecated or not. Defaults to `false`.|

## Update strategy segments

<a id="opIdupdateFeatureStrategySegments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://app.getunleash.io/demo/api/admin/segments/strategies \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "projectId": "red-vista",
    "strategyId": "15d1e20b-6310-4e17-a0c2-9fb84de3053a",
    "environmentId": "development",
    "segmentIds": [
      1,
      5,
      6
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/admin/segments/strategies`

Sets the segments of the strategy specified to be exactly the ones passed in the payload. Any segments that were used by the strategy before will be removed if they are not in the provided list of segments.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "projectId": "red-vista",
  "strategyId": "15d1e20b-6310-4e17-a0c2-9fb84de3053a",
  "environmentId": "development",
  "segmentIds": [
    1,
    5,
    6
  ]
}
```

|» strategyId|body|string|true|The ID of the strategy to update segments for.|
|» environmentId|body|string|true|The ID of the strategy environment.|
|» segmentIds|body|[integer]|true|The new list of segments (IDs) to use for this strategy. Any segments not in this list will be removed from the strategy.|

```bash
curl https://app.getunleash.io/demo/api/admin/tags/string/string/rename \
```

`POST /api/admin/tags/{type}/{value}/rename`

Change the value of a tag. Every feature flag that has the tag gets the new value. If a tag with the new value already exists, the two are merged.

```json
{
  "value": "a-new-tag-value"
}
```

|» value|body|string|true|The new value of the tag. The value must be between 2 and 50 characters long. If the value already exists for the same tag type, the two tags are merged. Leading and trailing whitespace is ignored and will be trimmed before saving the tag value.|

## Adds a tag to the specified features

<a id="opIdaddTagToFeatures"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://app.getunleash.io/demo/api/admin/projects/string/tags \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "features": [
      "string"
    ],
    "tags": {
      "addedTags": [
        {
          "value": "tag-to-add",
          "type": "simple"
        }
      ],
      "removedTags": [
        {
          "value": "tag-to-remove",
          "type": "simple"
        }
      ]
    }
  }'
```

`PUT /api/admin/projects/{projectId}/tags`

<h3 id="register-edge-observability-metrics-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[edgeInstanceDataSchema](#schemaedgeinstancedataschema)|true|edgeInstanceDataSchema|
|» identifier|body|string|true|The ID of the Edge process, typically a ULID. Newly generated for each restart of the instance.|
|» appName|body|string|true|The name of the application, configured by the user, typically persistent across restarts of Edge.|
|» region|body|string \| null|false|Which region the Edge instance is running in. Set to AWS_REGION by default (if present).|
|» edgeVersion|body|string|true|Which version (semver) of Edge is the Edge instance running.|
|» processMetrics|body|[edgeProcessMetricsSchema](#schemaedgeprocessmetricsschema)|false|Represents Edge instance resource usage data.|
|» started|body|string(date-time)|true|RFC3339 timestamp for when the Edge instance was started.|
|» traffic|body|[edgeInstanceTrafficSchema](#schemaedgeinstancetrafficschema)|true|Represents requests to the Edge instance (/api/client/features, /api/frontend, etc.)|
|» latencyUpstream|body|[edgeUpstreamLatencySchema](#schemaedgeupstreamlatencyschema)|true|Latencies for upstream actions from Edge (downloading/syncing new features, uploading metrics, uploading instance data)|
|» enricherMetrics|body|object \| null|false|Context enrichment request latency, errors, and timeouts.|
|» » traffic|body|[edgeLatencyMetricsSchema](#schemaedgelatencymetricsschema)|true|Representing latency for an Edge operation.|
|» » errors|body|integer|true|none|
|» » timeouts|body|integer|true|none|
|» connectedStreamingClients|body|number|true|How many streaming clients are connected to the Edge instance.|
|» connectedEdges|body|[[edgeInstanceDataSchema](#schemaedgeinstancedataschema)]|true|A list of Edge instances connected to the Edge instance.|
|» requestsSinceLastReport|body|[edgeRequestStatsSchema](#schemaedgerequeststatsschema)|false|Requests made to edge's endpoints since last report. Meant to be used for billing purposes.|
|» connectionConsumptionSinceLastReport|body|[connectionConsumptionSchema](#schemaconnectionconsumptionschema)|false|Connection consumption data since last report, including features and metrics consumption. Used for long-lived backend SDKs with backend controlled number of instances.|
|» requestConsumptionSinceLastReport|body|[requestConsumptionSchema](#schemarequestconsumptionschema)|false|Request consumption data since last report, grouped by metered group. Used for frontend SDKs with unpredictable and potentially large number of user devices running those SDKs.|
|» hosting|body|string|false|A marker that tells Unleash whether this Edge instance is self-hosted, enterprise self-hosted, or hosted by Unleash.|
|» apiKeyRevisionIds|body|[[edgeApiKeyRevisionIdSchema](#schemaedgeapikeyrevisionidschema)]|false|List of API keys (represented by their environment and projects) and revision ids to make it easier to track sync state of edge|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» hosting|hosted|
|» hosting|self-hosted|
|» hosting|enterprise-self-hosted|

<h3 id="register-edge-observability-metrics-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|202|Accepted|This response has no body.|None|

## Send metrics in bulk

```bash
curl https://app.getunleash.io/demo/api/client/metrics/bulk \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "applications": [
      {
        "connectVia": [
          {
            "appName": "unleash-edge",
            "instanceId": "edge-pod-bghzv5"
          }
        ],
        "appName": "Ingress load balancer",
        "environment": "development",
        "instanceId": "application-name-dacb1234",
        "interval": 10,
        "started": "1952-03-11T12:00:00.000Z",
        "strategies": [
          "standard",
          "gradualRollout"
        ],
        "projects": [
          "projectA",
          "projectB"
        ],
        "sdkVersion": "unleash-client-java:8.0.0",
        "sdkType": "backend",
        "sdkFlavor": "unleash-openfeature-node-provider",
        "sdkFlavorVersion": "1.0.1"
      }
    ],
    "metrics": [
      {
        "featureName": "my.special.feature",
        "appName": "accounting",
        "environment": "development",
        "timestamp": "1926-05-08T12:00:00.000Z",
        "yes": 974,
        "no": 50,
        "variants": {
          "variantA": 15,
          "variantB": 25,
          "variantC": 5
        }
      }
    ],
    "impactMetrics": [
      {
        "name": "my-counter",
        "help": "Counts the number of operations",
        "type": "counter",
        "samples": [
          {
            "value": 10,
            "labels": {
              "application": "my-app",
              "environment": "production"
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "seenTokens": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

## Check which tokens are valid

```bash
curl https://app.getunleash.io/demo/edge/validate \
  -X POST \

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "tokens": [

      "[]:production.randomstring"
```

`POST /edge/validate`

This operation accepts a list of tokens to validate. Unleash will validate each token you provide. For each valid token you provide, Unleash will return the token along with its type and which projects it has access to.

|» name|body|string|false|The user's name (not the user's username).|

```json
{
  "provider": "webhook",
  "description": "This addon posts updates to our internal feature tracking system whenever a feature is created or updated.",
  "enabled": true,
  "parameters": {
    "url": "http://localhost:4242/webhook"
  },
  "events": [
    "feature-created",
    "feature-updated"
  ],

    "development",
    "production"

```

Data required to create or update an [Unleash addon](https://docs.getunleash.io/integrate) instance.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|provider|string|true|none|The addon provider, such as "webhook" or "slack". This string is **case sensitive** and maps to the provider's `name` property.<br><br>The list of all supported providers and their parameters for a specific Unleash instance can be found by making a GET request to the `api/admin/addons` endpoint: the `providers` property of that response will contain all available providers.<br><br>The default set of providers can be found in the [addons reference documentation](https://docs.getunleash.io/integrate). The default supported options are:<br>- `datadog` for [Datadog](https://docs.getunleash.io/integrate/datadog)<br>- `slack` for [Slack](https://docs.getunleash.io/integrate/slack)<br>- `teams-workflow` for [Microsoft Teams Workflow](https://docs.getunleash.io/integrate/teams-workflow)<br>- `webhook` for [webhooks](https://docs.getunleash.io/integrate/webhook)<br><br>The provider you choose for your addon dictates what properties the `parameters` object needs. Refer to the documentation for each provider for more information.<br>|
|description|string|false|none|A description of the addon.|
|enabled|boolean|true|none|Whether the addon should be enabled or not.|
|parameters|object|true|none|Parameters for the addon provider. This object has different required and optional properties depending on the provider you choose. Consult the documentation for details.|
|events|[string]|true|none|The event types that will trigger this specific addon.|
|projects|[string]|false|none|The projects that this addon will listen to events from. An empty list means it will listen to events from **all** projects.|
|environments|[string]|false|none|The list of environments that this addon will listen to events from. An empty list means it will listen to events from **all** environments.|

An addon parameter definition.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the parameter as it is used in code. References to this parameter should use this value.|
|displayName|string|true|none|The name of the parameter as it is shown to the end user in the Admin UI.|
|type|string|true|none|The type of the parameter. Corresponds roughly to [HTML `input` field types](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/HTML/Element/Input#input_types). Multi-line input fields are indicated as `textfield` (equivalent to the HTML `textarea` tag). Collections of user-defined key-value pairs are indicated as `keyvaluepairs`.|
|description|string|false|none|A description of the parameter. This should explain to the end user what the parameter is used for.|
|placeholder|string|false|none|The default value for this parameter. This value is used if no other value is provided.|
|required|boolean|true|none|Whether this parameter is required or not. If a parameter is required, you must give it a value when you create the addon. If it is not required it can be left out. It may receive a default value in those cases. Parameters of type `keyvaluepairs` ignore this attribute.|
|sensitive|boolean|true|none|Indicates whether this parameter is **sensitive** or not. Unleash will not return sensitive parameters to API requests. It will instead use a number of asterisks to indicate that a value is set, e.g. "******". The number of asterisks does not correlate to the parameter's value. Parameters of type `keyvaluepairs` ignore this attribute.|

An [addon](https://docs.getunleash.io/integrate) instance description. Contains data about what kind of provider it uses, whether it's enabled or not, what events it listens for, and more.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|integer|true|none|The addon's unique identifier.|
|provider|string|true|none|The addon provider, such as "webhook" or "slack".|
|description|string \| null|true|none|A description of the addon. `null` if no description exists.|
|enabled|boolean|true|none|Whether the addon is enabled or not.|
|parameters|object|true|none|Parameters for the addon provider. This object has different required and optional properties depending on the provider you choose.|
|events|[string]|true|none|The event types that trigger this specific addon.|
|projects|[string]|false|none|The projects that this addon listens to events from. An empty list means it listens to events from **all** projects.|
|environments|[string]|false|none|The list of environments that this addon listens to events from. An empty list means it listens to events from **all** environments.|

An addon provider. Defines a specific addon type and what the end user must configure when creating a new addon of that type.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the addon type. When creating new addons, this goes in the payload's `type` field.|
|displayName|string|true|none|The addon type's name as it should be displayed in the admin UI.|
|documentationUrl|string|true|none|A URL to where you can find more information about using this addon type.|
|description|string|true|none|A description of the addon type.|
|howTo|string|false|none|A long description of how to use this addon type. This will be displayed on the top of configuration page. Can contain markdown.|
|tagTypes|[[tagTypeSchema](#schematagtypeschema)]|false|none|A list of [Unleash tag types](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/feature-flags#tags) that this addon uses. These tags will be added to the Unleash instance when an addon of this type is created.|
|parameters|[[addonParameterSchema](#schemaaddonparameterschema)]|false|none|The addon provider's parameters. Use these to configure an addon of this provider type. Items with `required: true` must be provided.|
|events|[string]|false|none|All the [event types](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/events#event-types) that are available for this addon provider.|
|installation|object|false|none|The installation configuration for this addon type.|
|serverInstallation|object|false|none|This is an experimental property. It may change or be removed as we work on it. Please don't depend on it yet. An installation that Unleash handles itself: the install button opens `path` in the same tab, with the non-sensitive parameters filled in the form as `parameters[name]` query parameters.|
|fixedEvents|boolean|false|none|This is an experimental property. It may change or be removed as we work on it. Please don't depend on it yet. Whether every addon of this type listens to all of its `events`. Hides filter from the form.|
|environmentIndependent|boolean|false|none|This is an experimental property. It may change or be removed as we work on it. Please don't depend on it yet. Whether the events of this addon type are independent of environments, so that no environment filter is offered.|
|alerts|[object]|false|none|A list of alerts to display to the user when installing addons of this type.|
|deprecated|string|false|none|This should be used to inform the user that this addon type is deprecated and should not be used. Deprecated addons will show a badge with this information on the UI.|

An object containing two things:
1. A list of all [addons](https://docs.getunleash.io/integrate) defined on this Unleash instance
2. A list of all addon providers defined on this instance

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|addons|[[addonSchema](#schemaaddonschema)]|true|none|All the addons that exist on this instance of Unleash.|
|providers|[[addonTypeSchema](#schemaaddontypeschema)]|true|none|A list of  all available addon providers, along with their parameters and descriptions.|

A description of a [segment](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/segments)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|integer|true|none|The ID of this segment|
|name|string|true|none|The name of this segment|
|description|string \| null|false|none|The description for this segment|
|constraints|[[constraintSchema](#schemaconstraintschema)]|true|none|The list of constraints that are used in this segment|
|usedInFeatures|integer \| null|false|none|The number of feature flags that use this segment. The number also includes the any flags with pending change requests that would add this segment.|
|usedInProjects|integer \| null|false|none|The number of projects that use this segment. The number includes any projects with pending change requests that would add this segment.|
|project|string \| null|false|none|The project the segment belongs to. Only present if the segment is a project-specific segment.|
|createdBy|string \| null|false|none|The creator's email or username|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|none|When the segment was created|

A simplified feature flag model intended for the Unleash playground.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The feature's name.|
|environment|string|true|none|The feature's environment.|
|context|[sdkFlatContextSchema](#schemasdkflatcontextschema)|true|none|The context to use when evaluating flags|
|projectId|string|true|none|The ID of the project that contains this feature.|
|strategies|object|true|none|Feature's applicable strategies and cumulative results of the strategies|
|isEnabledInCurrentEnvironment|boolean|true|none|Whether the feature is active and would be evaluated in the provided environment in a normal SDK context.|
|isEnabled|boolean|true|none|Whether this feature is enabled or not in the current environment.<br>                          If a feature can't be fully evaluated (that is, `strategies.result` is `unknown`),<br>                          this will be `false` to align with how client SDKs treat unresolved feature states.|
|variant|object \| null|true|none|The feature variant you receive based on the provided context or the _disabled<br>                          variant_. If a feature is disabled or doesn't have any<br>                          variants, you would get the _disabled variant_.<br>                          Otherwise, you'll get one of the feature's defined variants.|
|variants|[[variantSchema](#schemavariantschema)]|true|none|The feature variants.|

```json
{
  "secret": "project:environment.xyzrandomstring",
  "tokenName": "some-user",
  "type": "client",
  "environment": "development",
  "project": "developerexperience",
  "projects": [
    "developerexperience",
    "enterprisegrowth"
  ],
  "expiresAt": "2023-04-19T08:15:14.000Z",
  "createdAt": "2023-04-19T08:15:14.000Z",
  "seenAt": "2023-04-19T08:15:14.000Z",

  "secure": true
}
```

An overview of an [Unleash API token](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/api-tokens-and-client-keys).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|secret|string \| null|false|none|The token used for authentication.|
|tokenName|string|true|none|A unique name for this particular token|
|type|string|true|none|The type of API token|
|environment|string|false|none|The environment the token has access to.|
|project|string|false|none|The project this token belongs to.|
|projects|[string]|true|none|The list of projects this token has access to. If the token has access to specific projects they will be listed here. If the token has access to all projects it will be represented as `[*]`|
|expiresAt|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The token's expiration date. NULL if the token doesn't have an expiration set.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|none|When the token was created.|
|seenAt|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When the token was last seen/used to authenticate with. NULL if the token has not yet been used for authentication.|
|alias|string \| null|false|none|Alias is no longer in active use and will often be NULL. It's kept around as a way of allowing old proxy tokens created with the old metadata format to keep working.|
|secure|boolean \| null|false|none|True if using the new api token format. This means copy token will no longer work|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|client|
|type|admin|
|type|frontend|
|type|backend|

|icon|string|false|none|An URL to an icon file to be used for the applications's entry in the application list|

An application registration. Defines the format POSTed by our backend SDKs when they're starting up

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|connectVia|[object]|false|none|A list of applications this app registration has been registered through. If connected directly to Unleash, this is an empty list. <br> This can be used in later visualizations to tell how many levels of proxy or Edge instances our SDKs have connected through|
|appName|string|true|none|The name of the application that is evaluating toggles|
|environment|string|true|none|Which environment the application is running in|
|instanceId|string|true|none|A [(somewhat) unique identifier](https://docs.getunleash.io/sdks/node#advanced-usage) for the application|
|interval|number|false|none|How often (in seconds) the application refreshes its features|
|started|[dateSchema](#schemadateschema)|false|none|The application started at|
|strategies|[string]|false|none|Enabled [strategies](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/activation-strategies) in the application|
|projects|[string]|false|none|The list of projects used in the application|
|sdkVersion|string|false|none|The version the sdk is running. Typically <client>:<version>|
|sdkType|string \| null|false|none|The sdk type|
|sdkFlavor|string|false|none|The identifier of an integration built on top of an Unleash SDK (e.g. an OpenFeature provider), forwarded by Edge so adoption of the integration can be tracked alongside sdkVersion.|
|sdkFlavorVersion|string|false|none|The version of the integration identified by sdkFlavor.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|sdkType|frontend|
|sdkType|backend|
|sdkType|null|

A client application is an instance of one of our SDKs

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|appName|string|true|none|An identifier for the app that uses the sdk, should be static across SDK restarts|
|instanceId|string|false|none|A unique identifier identifying the instance of the application running the SDK. Often changes based on execution environment. For instance: two pods in Kubernetes will have two different instanceIds|
|sdkVersion|string|false|none|An SDK version identifier. Usually formatted as "unleash-client-<language>:<version>"|
|platformName|string|false|none|The platform the application is running on. For languages that compile to binaries, this can be omitted|
|platformVersion|string|false|none|The version of the platform the application is running on. Languages that compile to binaries, this is expected to be the compiler version used to assemble the binary.|
|yggdrasilVersion|string|false|none|The semantic version of the Yggdrasil engine used by the client. If the client is using a native engine this can be omitted.|
|specVersion|string|false|none|The version of the Unleash client specification the client supports|
|sdkFlavor|string|false|none|The identifier of an integration built on top of an Unleash SDK (e.g. an OpenFeature provider). Sent so adoption of the integration can be tracked alongside sdkVersion.|
|sdkFlavorVersion|string|false|none|The version of the integration identified by sdk flavor, that has been built on top of an Unleash SDK|
|interval|number|true|none|How often (in seconds) does the client refresh its toggles|
|started|string(date-time) \| number|true|none|Either an RFC-3339 timestamp or a unix timestamp in seconds|
|strategies|[string]|true|none|Which strategies the SDKs runtime knows about|

```json
      "featureName": "myAwesomeFeature",

      "segments": [
        1,

      ],
      "constraints": [

          "contextName": "appName",

      ],
      "parameters": {
        "property1": "string",
        "property2": "string"
      }
    }

  "variants": [

      "weight": 0,
      "weightType": "variable",
      "stickiness": "custom.context.field",
      "payload": {
        "type": "json",
        "value": "{\"color\": \"red\"}"
      },
      "overrides": [
        {
          "contextName": "userId",
          "values": [
            "red",
            "blue"
```

Feature flag configuration used by SDKs to evaluate state of a flag

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The unique name of a feature flag. Is validated to be URL safe on creation|
|type|string|false|none|What kind of feature flag is this. Refer to the documentation on [feature flag types](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/feature-flags#feature-flag-types) for more information|
|enabled|boolean|true|none|Whether the feature flag is enabled for the current API key or not. This is ANDed with the evaluation results of the strategies list, so if this is false, the evaluation result will always be false|
|impressionData|boolean \| null|false|none|Set to true if SDKs should trigger [impression events](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/impression-data) when this flag is evaluated|
|project|string|false|none|Which project this feature flag belongs to|
|strategies|[[featureStrategySchema](#schemafeaturestrategyschema)]|false|none|Evaluation strategies for this flag. Each entry in this list will be evaluated and ORed together|
|variants|[[variantSchema](#schemavariantschema)]|false|none|[Variants](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/feature-flag-variants#what-are-variants) configured for this flag|
|dependencies|[[dependentFeatureSchema](#schemadependentfeatureschema)]|false|none|Feature dependencies for this flag|

```json
              "values": [
                "red",
                "blue"
              ]
            }
          ]
        }
      ],
      "dependencies": [
        {
          "feature": "parent_feature",
          "enabled": false,
          "variants": [
            "variantA",
            "variantB"
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "segments": [
    {
      "id": 0,
      "name": "segment A",
      "constraints": [
        {
          "contextName": "appName",
          "operator": "IN",
          "caseInsensitive": false,
          "inverted": false,
          "values": [
            "my-app",
            "my-other-app"
          ],
          "value": "my-app"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "query": {
    "tag": [
      [
        "simple:payment",
        "simple:stripejourney"
      ]
    ],
    "project": [
      "new.payment.flow"
    ],
    "namePrefix": "payment",
    "environment": "string",
    "inlineSegmentConstraints": true
  }
}
```

Configuration data for backend SDKs for evaluating feature flags.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|version|number|true|none|A version number for the format used in the response. Most Unleash instances now return version 2, which includes segments as a separate array|
|features|[[clientFeatureSchema](#schemaclientfeatureschema)]|true|none|A list of feature flags with their configuration|
|segments|[[clientSegmentSchema](#schemaclientsegmentschema)]|false|none|A list of [Segments](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/segments) configured for this Unleash instance|
|query|[clientFeaturesQuerySchema](#schemaclientfeaturesqueryschema)|false|none|A summary of filters and parameters sent to the endpoint. Used by the server to build the features and segments response|

|platformName|string|false|none|The platform the application is running on. For languages that compile to binaries, this can be omitted|
|platformVersion|string|false|none|The version of the platform the application is running on. Languages that compile to binaries, this is expected to be the compiler version used to assemble the binary.|
|yggdrasilVersion|string|false|none|The semantic version of the Yggdrasil engine used by the client. If the client is using a native engine this can be omitted.|

|bucket|object \| null|false|none|Holds all metrics gathered over a window of time. Typically 1 hour wide. May be omitted or null when the request only carries impact metrics.|

A strategy constraint. For more information, refer to [the strategy constraint reference documentation](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/activation-strategies#constraints)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|contextName|string|true|none|The name of the context field that this constraint should apply to.|
|operator|string|true|none|The operator to use when evaluating this constraint. For more information about the various operators, refer to [the strategy constraint operator documentation](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/activation-strategies#constraint-operators).|
|caseInsensitive|boolean|false|none|Whether the operator should be case sensitive or not. Defaults to `false` (being case sensitive).|
|inverted|boolean|false|none|Whether the result should be negated or not. If `true`, will turn a `true` result into a `false` result and vice versa.|
|values|[string]|false|none|The context values that should be used for constraint evaluation. Use this property instead of `value` for properties that accept multiple values.|
|value|string|false|none|The context value that should be used for constraint evaluation. Use this property instead of `values` for properties that only accept single values.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|operator|NOT_IN|
|operator|IN|
|operator|STR_ENDS_WITH|
|operator|STR_STARTS_WITH|
|operator|STR_CONTAINS|
|operator|NUM_EQ|
|operator|NUM_GT|
|operator|NUM_GTE|
|operator|NUM_LT|
|operator|NUM_LTE|
|operator|DATE_AFTER|
|operator|DATE_BEFORE|
|operator|SEMVER_EQ|
|operator|SEMVER_GT|
|operator|SEMVER_LT|
|operator|SEMVER_GTE|
|operator|SEMVER_LTE|
|operator|REGEX|
|operator|IN_CIDR|

The data required to create an [Unleash API token](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/api-tokens-and-client-keys).

```json
{
  "name": "my-custom-strategy",
```

The data required to create a strategy type. Refer to the docs on [custom strategy types](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/activation-strategies#custom-strategies) for more information.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|title|string|false|none|The title of the strategy|
|description|string|false|none|A description of the strategy type.|
|editable|boolean|false|none|Whether the strategy type is editable or not. Defaults to `true`.|
|deprecated|boolean|false|none|Whether the strategy type is deprecated or not. Defaults to `false`.|
|parameters|[object]|true|none|The parameter list lets you pass arguments to your custom activation strategy. These will be made available to your custom strategy implementation.|

<h2 id="tocS_createStrategyVariantSchema">createStrategyVariantSchema</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacreatestrategyvariantschema"></a>
<a id="schema_createStrategyVariantSchema"></a>
<a id="tocScreatestrategyvariantschema"></a>
<a id="tocscreatestrategyvariantschema"></a>

```json
{
  "name": "blue_group",
  "weight": 0,
  "weightType": "fix",
  "stickiness": "custom.context.field",
  "payload": {
    "type": "json",
    "value": "{\"color\": \"red\"}"
  }
}
```

Strategy variants allow you to attach any data to strategies instead of only returning `true`/`false`. Strategy variants take precedence over environment-level variants.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The variant name. Must be unique for this feature flag|
|weight|integer|true|none|The weight is the likelihood of any one user getting this variant. It is an integer between 0 and 1000. See the section on [variant weights](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/feature-flag-variants#variant-weight) for more information|
|weightType|string|true|none|Set to `fix` if this variant must have exactly the weight allocated to it. If the type is `variable`, the weight will adjust so that the total weight of all variants adds up to 1000. Refer to the [variant weight documentation](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/feature-flag-variants#variant-weight).|
|stickiness|string|true|none|The [stickiness](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/feature-flag-variants#variant-stickiness) to use for distribution of this variant. Stickiness is how Unleash guarantees that the same user gets the same variant every time|
|payload|object|false|none|Extra data configured for this variant|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|weightType|variable|
|weightType|fix|

|rootRole|integer \| string|true|none|The role to assign to the user. Can be either the role's ID or its unique name.|
|sendEmail|boolean|false|none|Whether to send a welcome email with a login link to the user or not. Defaults to `true`.|

<h2 id="tocS_edgeTokenSchema">edgeTokenSchema</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaedgetokenschema"></a>
<a id="schema_edgeTokenSchema"></a>
<a id="tocSedgetokenschema"></a>
<a id="tocsedgetokenschema"></a>

```json
{
  "projects": [
    "developerexperience",
    "enterprisegrowth"
  ],
  "environment": "development",
  "type": "client",
  "token": "*:development.5c806b5320c88cf27e81f3e9b97dab298a77d5879316e3c2d806206b"
}
```

A representation of a client token, limiting access to [CLIENT](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/api-tokens-and-client-keys#backend-tokens) (used by serverside SDKs) or [FRONTEND](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/api-tokens-and-client-keys#frontend-tokens) (used by proxy SDKs)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|projects|[string]|true|none|The list of projects this token has access to. If the token has access to specific projects they will be listed here. If the token has access to all projects it will be represented as [`*`]|
|environment|string|true|none|The environment this token as access to|
|type|string|true|none|The [API token](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/api-tokens-and-client-keys)'s **type**. Unleash supports three different types of API tokens ([ADMIN](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/api-tokens-and-client-keys#admin-tokens), [CLIENT](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/api-tokens-and-client-keys#backend-tokens), [FRONTEND](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/api-tokens-and-client-keys#frontend-tokens)). They all have varying access, so when validating a token it's important to know what kind you're dealing with|
|token|string|true|none|The actual token value. [Unleash API tokens](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/api-tokens-and-client-keys) are comprised of three parts. <project(s)>:<environment>.randomcharacters|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|client|
|type|admin|
|type|frontend|
|type|backend|

Describes a project's configuration in a given environment.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the environment|

|protected|boolean|true|none|`true` if the environment is protected, otherwise `false`. A *protected* environment can not be deleted.|
|sortOrder|integer|true|none|Priority of the environment in a list of environments, the lower the value, the higher up in the list the environment will appear|
|projectApiTokenCount|integer|false|none|The number of client and front-end API tokens that have access to this project|
|projectEnabledToggleCount|integer|false|none|The number of features enabled in this environment for this project|
|defaultStrategy|[featureStrategySchema](#schemafeaturestrategyschema)|false|none|The strategy configuration to add when enabling a feature environment by default|
|visible|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the environment can be enabled for feature flags in the project|
|requiredApprovals|integer \| null|false|none|Experimental field. The number of approvals required before a change request can be applied in this environment.|

|features|[[featureSchema](#schemafeatureschema)]|true|none|All the exported features.|

|featureEnvironments|[[featureEnvironmentSchema](#schemafeatureenvironmentschema)]|false|none|Environment-specific configuration for all the features in the `features` list. Includes data such as whether the feature is enabled in the selected export environment, whether there are any variants assigned, etc.|
|contextFields|[[contextFieldSchema](#schemacontextfieldschema)]|false|none|A list of all the context fields that are in use by any of the strategies in the `featureStrategies` list.|
|featureTags|[[featureTagSchema](#schemafeaturetagschema)]|false|none|A list of all the tags that have been applied to any of the features in the `features` list.|
|segments|[object]|false|none|A list of all the segments that are used by the strategies in the `featureStrategies` list.|
|tagTypes|[[tagTypeSchema](#schematagtypeschema)]|true|none|A list of all of the tag types that are used in the `featureTags` list.|
|dependencies|[[featureDependenciesSchema](#schemafeaturedependenciesschema)]|false|none|A list of all the dependencies for features in `features` list.|
|links|[[featureLinksSchema](#schemafeaturelinksschema)]|false|none|A list of links for features in `features` list.|

A detailed description of the feature environment

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the environment|
|featureName|string|false|none|The name of the feature|
|environment|string|false|none|The name of the environment|
|type|string|false|none|The type of the environment|
|enabled|boolean|true|none|`true` if the feature is enabled for the environment, otherwise `false`.|
|sortOrder|number|false|none|The sort order of the feature environment in the feature environments list|
|variantCount|number|false|none|The number of defined variants|
|strategies|[[featureStrategySchema](#schemafeaturestrategyschema)]|false|none|A list of activation strategies for the feature environment|
|variants|[[variantSchema](#schemavariantschema)]|false|none|A list of variants for the feature environment|
|changeRequestIds|[number]|false|none|Experimental. A list of change request identifiers for actionable change requests that are not Cancelled, Rejected or Approved.|
|milestoneName|string|false|none|Experimental: The name of the currently active release plan milestone|
|milestoneOrder|number|false|none|Experimental: The zero-indexed order of currently active milestone in the list of all release plan milestones|
|totalMilestones|number|false|none|Experimental: The total number of milestones in the feature environment release plan|
|lastSeenAt|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date when metrics where last collected for the feature environment|
|hasStrategies|boolean|false|none|Whether the feature has any strategies defined.|
|hasEnabledStrategies|boolean|false|none|Whether the feature has any enabled strategies defined.|
|releasePlans|[[releasePlanSchema](#schemareleaseplanschema)]|false|none|Release plans for this feature environment|
|safeguards|[[featureEnvironmentSafeguardSchema](#schemafeatureenvironmentsafeguardschema)]|false|none|Safeguards for this feature environment|
|yes|integer|false|none|How many times the feature evaluated to true (enabled)|
|no|integer|false|none|How many times the feature evaluated to false (disabled)|

A feature flag definition

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|Unique feature name|
|type|string|false|none|Type of the flag e.g. experiment, kill-switch, release, operational, permission|
|description|string \| null|false|none|Detailed description of the feature|
|archived|boolean|false|none|`true` if the feature is archived|
|project|string|false|none|Name of the project the feature belongs to|
|enabled|boolean|false|none|`true` if the feature is enabled, otherwise `false`.|
|stale|boolean|false|none|`true` if the feature is stale based on the age and feature type, otherwise `false`.|
|favorite|boolean|false|none|`true` if the feature was favorited, otherwise `false`.|
|impressionData|boolean|false|none|`true` if the impression data collection is enabled for the feature, otherwise `false`.|
|createdAt|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date the feature was created|
|createdBy|object|false|none|User who created the feature flag|
|archivedAt|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date the feature was archived|
|environments|[[featureEnvironmentSchema](#schemafeatureenvironmentschema)]|false|none|The list of environments where the feature can be used|
|tags|[[tagSchema](#schematagschema)]|false|none|The list of feature tags|
|children|[string]|false|none|The list of child feature names. This is an experimental field and may change.|
|lifecycle|object|false|none|Current lifecycle stage of the feature|
|dependencies|[object]|false|none|The list of parent dependencies. This is an experimental field and may change.|
|collaborators|object|false|none|Information related to users who have made changes to this feature flage.|
|links|[object]|false|none|The list of links. This is an experimental field and may change.|
|payloadSchema|object|false|none|The JSON Schema document, draft 2020-12, that describes the variant payloads of the flag. Absent when the flag has none. This is an experimental field and may change.|
|lifetimeDays|integer|false|none|The lifetime of this flag in days. If the value is `0`, the flag is expected to be permanent. Absent when the flag uses the lifetime of its feature type. This is an experimental field and may change.|
|expectedLifetimeEndsAt|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date the flag is expected to reach the end of its lifetime. `null` if the flag is permanent. This is an experimental field and may change.|

A detailed description of the feature environment

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the environment|
|featureName|string|false|none|The name of the feature|
|environment|string|false|none|The name of the environment|
|type|string|true|none|The type of the environment|
|enabled|boolean|true|none|`true` if the feature is enabled for the environment, otherwise `false`.|
|sortOrder|number|false|none|The sort order of the feature environment in the feature environments list|
|variantCount|number|false|none|The number of defined variants|
|strategies|[[featureStrategySchema](#schemafeaturestrategyschema)]|false|none|A list of activation strategies for the feature environment|
|variants|[[variantSchema](#schemavariantschema)]|false|none|A list of variants for the feature environment|
|changeRequestIds|[number]|false|none|Experimental. A list of change request identifiers for actionable change requests that are not Cancelled, Rejected or Approved.|
|milestoneName|string|false|none|Experimental: The name of the currently active release plan milestone|
|milestoneOrder|number|false|none|Experimental: The zero-indexed order of currently active milestone in the list of all release plan milestones|
|totalMilestones|number|false|none|Experimental: The total number of milestones in the feature environment release plan|
|lastSeenAt|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date when metrics where last collected for the feature environment|
|hasStrategies|boolean|false|none|Whether the feature has any strategies defined.|
|hasEnabledStrategies|boolean|false|none|Whether the feature has any enabled strategies defined.|
|releasePlans|[[releasePlanSchema](#schemareleaseplanschema)]|false|none|Release plans for this feature environment|
|safeguards|[[featureEnvironmentSafeguardSchema](#schemafeatureenvironmentsafeguardschema)]|false|none|Safeguards for this feature environment|
|yes|integer|false|none|How many times the toggle evaluated to true in last hour bucket|
|no|integer|false|none|How many times the toggle evaluated to false in last hour bucket|

A feature flag definition

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|Unique feature name|
|type|string|true|none|Type of the flag e.g. experiment, kill-switch, release, operational, permission|
|description|string \| null|true|none|Detailed description of the feature|
|dependencyType|string \| null|true|none|The type of dependency. 'parent' means that the feature is a parent feature, 'child' means that the feature is a child feature.|
|project|string|true|none|Name of the project the feature belongs to|
|stale|boolean|true|none|`true` if the feature is stale based on the age and feature type, otherwise `false`.|
|favorite|boolean|true|none|`true` if the feature was favorited, otherwise `false`.|
|impressionData|boolean|true|none|`true` if the impression data collection is enabled for the feature, otherwise `false`.|
|createdAt|string(date-time) \| null|true|none|The date the feature was created|
|archivedAt|string(date-time) \| null|true|none|The date the feature was archived|
|environments|[[featureSearchEnvironmentSchema](#schemafeaturesearchenvironmentschema)]|true|none|The list of environments where the feature can be used|
|segments|[string]|true|none|The list of segments the feature is enabled for.|
|tags|[[tagSchema](#schematagschema)]|false|none|The list of feature tags|
|lifecycle|object|false|none|Current lifecycle stage of the feature|
|createdBy|object|true|none|User who created the feature flag|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|dependencyType|parent|
|dependencyType|child|
|dependencyType|null|

An overview of a project's stats and its health as described in the documentation on [technical debt](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/technical-debt)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|version|integer|true|none|The project overview version.|
|name|string|true|none|The project's name|
|description|string \| null|false|none|The project's description|
|defaultStickiness|string|true|none|A default stickiness for the project affecting the default stickiness value for variants and Gradual Rollout strategy|
|mode|string|true|none|The project's [collaboration mode](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/project-collaboration-mode). Determines whether non-project members can submit change requests or not.|
|featureLimit|number \| null|false|none|A limit on the number of features allowed in the project. Null if no limit.|
|members|integer|true|none|The number of users/members in the project.|
|health|integer|true|none|**Deprecated.** Use `technicalDebt` instead.|
|technicalDebt|number|true|none|An indicator of the [project's technical debt](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/technical-debt#project-status) on a scale from 0 to 100|
|environments|[[projectEnvironmentSchema](#schemaprojectenvironmentschema)]|true|none|An array containing the names of all the environments configured for the project.|
|features|[[featureSchema](#schemafeatureschema)]|true|none|An array containing an overview of all the features of the project and their individual status|
|updatedAt|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When the project was last updated.|
|createdAt|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When the project was last updated.|
|favorite|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the project has been marked as a favorite by the current user requesting the project health overview.|
|stats|[projectStatsSchema](#schemaprojectstatsschema)|false|none|Project statistics|
|featureNaming|[createFeatureNamingPatternSchema](#schemacreatefeaturenamingpatternschema)|false|none|Create a feature naming pattern|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|mode|open|
|mode|protected|
|mode|private|

A report of the current health of the requested project, with datapoints like counters of currently active, stale, and potentially stale feature flags.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|version|integer|true|none|The project overview version.|
|name|string|true|none|The project's name|
|description|string \| null|false|none|The project's description|
|defaultStickiness|string|true|none|A default stickiness for the project affecting the default stickiness value for variants and Gradual Rollout strategy|
|mode|string|true|none|The project's [collaboration mode](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/project-collaboration-mode). Determines whether non-project members can submit change requests or not.|
|featureLimit|number \| null|false|none|A limit on the number of features allowed in the project. Null if no limit.|
|members|integer|true|none|The number of users/members in the project.|
|health|integer|true|none|**Deprecated.** Use `technicalDebt` instead.|
|technicalDebt|number|true|none|An indicator of the [project's technical debt](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/technical-debt#project-status) on a scale from 0 to 100|
|environments|[[projectEnvironmentSchema](#schemaprojectenvironmentschema)]|true|none|An array containing the names of all the environments configured for the project.|
|features|[[featureSchema](#schemafeatureschema)]|true|none|An array containing an overview of all the features of the project and their individual status|
|updatedAt|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When the project was last updated.|
|createdAt|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When the project was last updated.|
|favorite|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the project has been marked as a favorite by the current user requesting the project health overview.|
|stats|[projectStatsSchema](#schemaprojectstatsschema)|false|none|Project statistics|
|featureNaming|[createFeatureNamingPatternSchema](#schemacreatefeaturenamingpatternschema)|false|none|Create a feature naming pattern|
|potentiallyStaleCount|number|true|none|The number of potentially stale feature flags.|
|activeCount|number|true|none|The number of active feature flags.|
|staleCount|number|true|none|The number of stale feature flags.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|mode|open|
|mode|protected|
|mode|private|

### Properties

|featureToggles|integer|false|none|The number of feature-toggles this instance has|
|projects|integer|false|none|The number of projects defined in this instance.|
|contextFields|integer|false|none|The number of context fields defined in this instance.|
|roles|integer|false|none|The number of roles defined in this instance|
|groups|integer|false|none|The number of groups defined in this instance|
|environments|integer|false|none|The number of environments defined in this instance|
|segments|integer|false|none|The number of segments defined in this instance|
|strategies|integer|false|none|The number of strategies defined in this instance|
|SAMLenabled|boolean|false|none|Whether or not SAML authentication is enabled for this instance|
|OIDCenabled|boolean|false|none|Whether or not OIDC authentication is enabled for this instance|
|clientApps|[object]|false|none|A count of connected applications in the last week, last month and all time since last restart|
|featureExports|integer|false|none|The number of export operations on this instance|
|featureImports|integer|false|none|The number of import operations on this instance|
|apiTokens|object|false|none|The number of API tokens in Unleash, split by type|
|maxEnvironmentStrategies|integer|false|none|The highest number of strategies used on a single feature flag in a single environment.|
|maxConstraints|integer|false|none|The highest number of constraints used on a single strategy.|
|maxConstraintValues|integer|false|none|The highest number of constraint values used on a single constraint.|
|releaseTemplates|integer|false|none|The number of release templates in this instance|
|releasePlans|integer|false|none|The number of release plans in this instance|
|edgeInstanceUsage|object|false|none|The average number of edge instances, per month, in the last 12 months, rounded to 3 decimal places|
|readOnlyUsers|integer|false|none|The number of ReadOnly users in this instance|
|sum|string|false|none|A SHA-256 checksum of the instance statistics to be used to verify that the data in this object has not been tampered with|

An object describing an integration event.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The integration event's ID. Integration event IDs are incrementing integers. In other words, a more recently created integration event will always have a higher ID than an older one. This ID is represented as a string since it is a BigInt.|
|integrationId|integer|true|none|The ID of the integration that the integration event belongs to.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time of when the integration event was created. In other words, the date and time of when the integration handled the event.|
|state|string|true|none|The state of the integration event. Can be one of `success`, `failed` or `successWithErrors`.|
|stateDetails|string|true|none|Details about the state of the integration event.|
|event|[eventSchema](#schemaeventschema)|true|none|The event that triggered this integration event.|
|details|object|true|none|Detailed information about the integration event. The contents vary depending on the type of integration and the specific details.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|state|success|
|state|failed|
|state|successWithErrors|

```json
  "description": "user:xyzrandomstring",
  "expiresAt": "2023-04-19T08:15:14.000Z"
}
```

Describes a [personal access token](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/api-tokens-and-client-keys#personal-access-tokens), or PAT. PATs are automatically scoped to the authenticated user.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|integer|true|none|The PAT's ID. PAT IDs are incrementing integers. In other words, a more recently created PAT will always have a higher ID than an older one.|
|secret|string|false|none|The token used for authentication. It is automatically generated by Unleash when the PAT is created and that is the only time this property is returned.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time of when the PAT was created.|
|seenAt|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When the PAT was last seen/used to authenticate with. `null` if it has not been used yet.|
|userId|integer|false|none|The ID of the user this PAT belongs to.|
|expiryWarning|string|false|none|A warning about the expiration of this PAT, absent when there is nothing to warn about. `expires-soon` means the PAT is past the middle of its lifetime and expires within one of the configured `tokenExpiryNotificationDays` lead times; `expired` means it is no longer usable.|
|description|string|true|none|The PAT's description.|
|expiresAt|string(date-time)|true|none|The PAT's expiration date.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|expiryWarning|expires-soon|
|expiryWarning|expired|

```json
  "caseInsensitive": false,

  "values": [
    "my-app",

```

A strategy constraint. For more information, refer to [the strategy constraint reference documentation](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/activation-strategies#constraints)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|contextName|string|true|none|The name of the context field that this constraint should apply to.|
|operator|string|true|none|The operator to use when evaluating this constraint. For more information about the various operators, refer to [the strategy constraint operator documentation](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/activation-strategies#constraint-operators).|
|caseInsensitive|boolean|false|none|Whether the operator should be case sensitive or not. Defaults to `false` (being case sensitive).|
|inverted|boolean|false|none|Whether the result should be negated or not. If `true`, will turn a `true` result into a `false` result and vice versa.|
|values|[string]|false|none|The context values that should be used for constraint evaluation. Use this property instead of `value` for properties that accept multiple values.|
|value|string|false|none|The context value that should be used for constraint evaluation. Use this property instead of `values` for properties that only accept single values.|
|result|boolean|true|none|Whether this was evaluated as true or false.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|operator|NOT_IN|
|operator|IN|
|operator|STR_ENDS_WITH|
|operator|STR_STARTS_WITH|
|operator|STR_CONTAINS|
|operator|NUM_EQ|
|operator|NUM_GT|
|operator|NUM_GTE|
|operator|NUM_LT|
|operator|NUM_LTE|
|operator|DATE_AFTER|
|operator|DATE_BEFORE|
|operator|SEMVER_EQ|
|operator|SEMVER_GT|
|operator|SEMVER_LT|
|operator|SEMVER_GTE|
|operator|SEMVER_LTE|
|operator|REGEX|
|operator|IN_CIDR|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|isEnabledInCurrentEnvironment|boolean|true|none|Whether the feature is active and would be evaluated in the provided environment in a normal SDK context.|
|isEnabled|boolean|true|none|Whether this feature is enabled or not in the current environment.<br>                          If a feature can't be fully evaluated (that is, `strategies.result` is `unknown`),<br>                          this will be `false` to align with how client SDKs treat unresolved feature states.|
|variant|object \| null|true|none|The feature variant you receive based on the provided context or the _disabled<br>                          variant_. If a feature is disabled or doesn't have any<br>                          variants, you would get the _disabled variant_.<br>                          Otherwise, you'll get one of thefeature's defined variants.|
|variants|[[variantSchema](#schemavariantschema)]|true|none|The feature variants.|

|name|string|true|none|The name of this project|
|description|string \| null|false|none|Additional information about the project|
|defaultStickiness|string|false|none|A default stickiness for the project affecting the default stickiness value for variants and Gradual Rollout strategy|
|mode|string|false|none|The project's [collaboration mode](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/project-collaboration-mode). Determines whether non-project members can submit change requests or not.|
|featureLimit|number \| null|false|none|A limit on the number of features allowed in the project. Null if no limit.|

|members|number|false|none|The number of members this project has|
|health|number|false|none|**Deprecated.** Use `technicalDebt` instead.|
|technicalDebt|number|false|none|An indicator of the [project's technical debt](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/technical-debt#project-status) on a scale from 0 to 100|
|environments|[[projectEnvironmentSchema](#schemaprojectenvironmentschema)]|false|none|The environments that are enabled for this project|
|featureTypeCounts|[[featureTypeCountSchema](#schemafeaturetypecountschema)]|false|none|The number of features of each type that are in this project|
|updatedAt|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When the project was last updated.|
|archivedAt|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When the project was archived.|
|createdAt|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When the project was created.|
|favorite|boolean|false|none|`true` if the project was favorited, otherwise `false`.|
|onboardingStatus|[onboardingStatusSchema](#schemaonboardingstatusschema)|true|none|The current onboarding status of a project.|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|mode|open|
|mode|protected|
|mode|private|

<h2 id="tocS_projectStatsSchema">projectStatsSchema</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaprojectstatsschema"></a>
<a id="schema_projectStatsSchema"></a>
<a id="tocSprojectstatsschema"></a>
<a id="tocsprojectstatsschema"></a>

```json
{
  "avgTimeToProdCurrentWindow": 10,
  "createdCurrentWindow": 15,
  "createdPastWindow": 15,
  "archivedCurrentWindow": 5,
  "archivedPastWindow": 5,
  "projectActivityCurrentWindow": 100,
  "projectActivityPastWindow": 100,
  "projectMembersAddedCurrentWindow": 1
}
```

Statistics for a project, including the average time to production, number of features created, the project activity and more.

Stats are divided into current and previous **windows**.
- The **current window** is the past 30 days.
- The **previous window** is the 30 days **before** the current window (from 60 to 30 days ago)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|avgTimeToProdCurrentWindow|number|true|none|The average time from when a feature was created to when it was enabled in the "production" environment during the current window|
|createdCurrentWindow|number|true|none|The number of feature flags created during the current window|
|createdPastWindow|number|true|none|The number of feature flags created during the previous window|
|archivedCurrentWindow|number|true|none|The number of feature flags that were archived during the current window|
|archivedPastWindow|number|true|none|The number of feature flags that were archived during the previous window|
|projectActivityCurrentWindow|number|true|none|The number of project events that occurred during the current window|
|projectActivityPastWindow|number|true|none|The number of project events that occurred during the previous window|
|projectMembersAddedCurrentWindow|number|true|none|The number of members that were added to the project during the current window|

|users|[[userSchema](#schemauserschema)]|false|none|Array of users that have signed up using the token.|
|role|[roleSchema](#schemaroleschema)|true|none|Users who sign up using this token will be given this role.|

Schema representing the creation of a release template.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The release plan/template's ID. Release template IDs are ulids.|
|discriminator|string|true|none|A field to distinguish between release plans and release templates.|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the release template.|
|description|string \| null|false|none|A description of the release template.|
|project|string \| null|false|none|The project this release template belongs to. `null` for global release templates available in all projects.|
|createdByUserId|number|true|none|Release template: The ID of the user who created this template.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time that the release template was created.|
|milestones|[[releasePlanMilestoneSchema](#schemareleaseplanmilestoneschema)]|false|none|A list of the milestones in this release template.|
|archivedAt|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date and time that the release template was archived.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|discriminator|template|

A map of resource names and their limits.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|segmentValues|integer|true|none|The maximum number of values per segment allowed.|
|strategySegments|integer|true|none|The maximum number of strategy segments allowed.|
|actionSetActions|integer|true|none|The maximum number of actions per action set allowed.|
|actionSetsPerProject|integer|true|none|The maximum number of action set definitions per project allowed.|
|actionSetFilters|integer|true|none|The maximum number of filters per action set allowed.|
|actionSetFilterValues|integer|true|none|The maximum number of filter values inside an action set allowed.|
|signalEndpoints|integer|true|none|The maximum number of signal endpoints allowed.|
|signalTokensPerEndpoint|integer|true|none|The maximum number of signal tokens per endpoint allowed.|
|featureEnvironmentStrategies|integer|true|none|The maximum number of feature environment strategies allowed.|
|constraintValues|integer|true|none|The maximum number of values for a single constraint.|
|constraints|integer|true|none|The maximum number of constraints in a single strategy.|
|environments|integer|true|none|The maximum number of environments allowed.|
|apiTokens|integer|true|none|The maximum number of SDK and admin API tokens you can have at the same time. This limit applies only to backend and frontend SDK tokens and to admin tokens. Personal access tokens are not subject to this limit. The limit applies to the total number of tokens across all projects in your organization.|
|projects|integer|true|none|The maximum number of projects allowed.|
|segments|integer|true|none|The maximum number of segments allowed.|
|featureFlags|integer|true|none|The maximum number of feature flags you can have at the same time. Archived flags do not count towards this limit.|
|releaseTemplates|integer|true|none|The maximum number of release templates allowed.|
|readOnlyUsers|integer|false|none|The maximum number of read-only users allowed.|

```json
  "project": "default"
}
```

A role holds permissions to allow Unleash to decide what actions a role holder is allowed to perform

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|integer|true|none|The role id|
|type|string|true|none|A role can either be a global root role (applies to all projects) or a project role|

|description|string|false|none|A more detailed description of the role and what use it's intended for|
|project|string \| null|false|none|What project the role belongs to|

<h2 id="tocS_strategyVariantSchema">strategyVariantSchema</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemastrategyvariantschema"></a>
<a id="schema_strategyVariantSchema"></a>
<a id="tocSstrategyvariantschema"></a>
<a id="tocsstrategyvariantschema"></a>

```json
{
  "name": "blue_group",
  "weight": 0,
  "weightType": "fix",
  "stickiness": "custom.context.field",
  "payload": {
    "type": "json",
    "value": "{\"color\": \"red\"}"
  }
}
```

Strategy variants allow you to attach any data to strategies instead of only returning `true`/`false`. Strategy variants take precedence over environment-level variants.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The variant name. Must be unique for this feature flag|
|weight|integer|true|none|The weight is the likelihood of any one user getting this variant. It is an integer between 0 and 1000. See the section on [variant weights](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/feature-flag-variants#variant-weight) for more information|
|weightType|string|true|none|Set to `fix` if this variant must have exactly the weight allocated to it. If the type is `variable`, the weight will adjust so that the total weight of all variants adds up to 1000. Refer to the [variant weight documentation](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/feature-flag-variants#variant-weight).|
|stickiness|string|true|none|The [stickiness](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/feature-flag-variants#variant-stickiness) to use for distribution of this variant. Stickiness is how Unleash guarantees that the same user gets the same variant every time|
|payload|object|false|none|Extra data configured for this variant|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|weightType|variable|
|weightType|fix|

|maintenanceMode|boolean|false|none|Whether maintenance mode is currently active or not.|
|resourceLimits|[resourceLimitsSchema](#schemaresourcelimitsschema)|false|none|A map of resource names and their limits.|
|prometheusAPIAvailable|boolean|false|none|Whether a Prometheus API is available.|
|impactMetrics|string|false|none|Impact metrics availability for this instance. `disabled` when the killswitch is on; `unconfigured` when no source is set up yet; `internal`/`external`/`full` depending on which data sources are available.|
|frontendApiOrigins|[string]|false|none|The list of origins that the front-end API should accept requests from.|
|flags|object|false|none|Additional (largely experimental) features that are enabled in this Unleash instance.|
|links|[object]|false|none|Relevant links to use in the UI.|
|authenticationType|string|false|none|The type of authentication enabled for this Unleash instance|
|versionInfo|[versionSchema](#schemaversionschema)|true|none|Detailed information about an Unleash version|
|oidcConfiguredThroughEnv|boolean|false|none|Whether the OIDC configuration is set through environment variables or not.|
|samlConfiguredThroughEnv|boolean|false|none|Whether the SAML configuration is set through environment variables or not.|
|maxSessionsCount|number|false|none|The maximum number of sessions that a user has.|
|unleashContext|object|false|none|The context object used to configure the Unleash instance.|
